'''M1-4X''', also known as an '''M1-4X Advanced War Droid''' or colloquially as '''Forex''', was a unique assault droid built by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Boab Deduun]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Initially developed under [[Project Ignition]] with a production cost of 15 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Forex was abandoned due to the complications with its power core but secretly completed by Deduun with the patronage of [[Harron Tavus]].

==Biography==
M1-4X was a prototype assault droid designed by the Republic but was abandoned due to their scientists being unable to activate its power core.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Republic Special Task Force/Legends|Republic Special Task Force]] defectors led by Captain [[Andrik]] salvaged M1-4X and attempted to fully activate him on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], using his own command codes to turn him against the Republic. [[Havoc Squad]], tasked with tracking down the traitors, encountered Forex and was forced to destroy the droid. [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] later rebuilt Forex to serve in Havoc Squad.

During his service with the squad, Forex, with his CO's leave, formed an initiative with Republic Command and the SIS to take down "impossible" Imperial targets to improve military morale: the [[Ambassador (Sith Empire)|Ambassador]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kavos]], and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rebus (Sith Empire)|Rebus]].

During the Eternal Empire's conquest, Forex's CO went missing, and Havoc was called to the front lines. For a year, he and Jorgan were stuck in trench warfare until the war was lost. Afterward, most of Havoc disbanded, with Yuun and Vik leaving the military, Dorne being removed from the Squad by Chancellor [[Leontyne Saresh|Saresh]], and Forex being called to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be used as a voice of freedom in the [[Press Corps]].<ref name="Booming" />

Four years after they lost the war, Forex was recruited into the Outlander's Alliance, dedicated to bringing an end to the Eternal Throne.<ref name="Booming" />

==Personality and traits==
Being a droid, M1-4X was programmed to be completely loyal, fervently patriotic, and willing and eager to go to any length or face any risk in order to destroy the Republic's enemies.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
M1-4X is a companion character for the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]] class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]]. He is voiced by [[Tom Kane]].

In the expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], M1-4X can only be recruited into the Alliance if the Outlander was one of the four classes aligned with the Republic, and even so, the player has to play 20 warzones to recruit him unless the Outlander is a Trooper. Otherwise, he would claim his programming prevented him from siding with an individual associated with the Sith Empire.
